theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_tc_weak_compactness
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ⨆ j, (Ts j).massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), StrictMono φ ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn (fun j => Ts (φ j)) C
